name: Briarcliff Manor Day Camps (Tree Camp, Super Camp, Camp Adventure)
operator_name: Village of Briarcliff Manor Recreation Department
description_short: Village day camps for children entering kindergarten to 6th grade who live in Briarcliff Manor or its school district: Tree Camp (K to 1) and Super Camp (2 to 3) at Law Park and the community center, and Camp Adventure (4 to 6) at the Briarcliff Youth Center, with sports, games, swimming and crafts. Camp Adventure takes a trip each week.
refund_policy_summary: If you register, you have about two weeks to cancel for a full refund less a processing fee and about a month for a 50% refund; after early March refunds are only for limited, documented reasons. (The FAQ says this policy was awaiting board approval when printed.)
notes: Prices shown are the school district resident rate; village residents pay $280 for week 1, $710 a session and $1,680 for all five weeks.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Day Camp FAQ for all four village camps: June 29 to July 31, 2026, no camp July 3; Tree Camp entering K and 1st, Super Camp 2nd and 3rd, Camp Adventure 4th to 6th, Camp Horizon 7th to 9th; Tree and Super at Law Park, WV Community Center and nearby, Todd School when it rains; Camp Adventure at the Briarcliff Youth Center; before camp from 8 am and after camp to 5 pm at the WJV Community Center for K to 6. Ages derived from grades. Indoor and outdoor inferred from park and community center sites.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Tree Camp sheet, for resident and school district resident children entering K or 1st: 9 to 3 at Law Park; playground, sports, games, instructional and free swim, arts and crafts. Fees resident / school district: Week 1 $280 / $350, Session 1 or 2 $710 / $890, 5 weeks $1,680 / $2,100. Camp Adventure's 2026 sheet lists the same fees. Session prices are the school district rate.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Camp Adventure sheet: entering 4th to 6th, 8:45 to 2:45 at the Briarcliff Manor Youth Center; sports and games, free swim, arts and crafts and a weekly trip to adventure courses, amusement parks and arcades.
Researched by Claude from this page. Village home page footer: Village Office, 1111 Pleasantville Road, Briarcliff Manor, NY 10510. The camp sheets give no ZIP.

for_andrew: Only Briarcliff Manor village residents and Briarcliff Manor school district residents (who pay a higher rate, recorded here) can enroll; nobody else. Andrew's rule for residents only camps: record the one rate, say who can enroll, and ask. List it?
One listing covers Tree Camp, Super Camp and Camp Adventure, since they share dates and fees, though Camp Adventure meets at the Youth Center rather than Law Park. Split them?
